title: One chicken explains why the rich get richer
chunks: each of them gets one chicken.
The second neighbour gets a hen
and eats one egg every morning.
So he knocks on her door
Let my rooster meet your hen,
Blob's yard fills up so fast
so he hires the first neighbour

cast.Blob: brand character: white round face, black short hair, teal shirt #1FA6A0, thin black line limbs, white round hands
cast.Ned (first neighbour): red shirt #E5484D, dark brown short hair, round blue glasses (friend template, seed chicken-a)
cast.Sara (second neighbour): pink shirt #E85D9E, brown ponytail, yellow beanie (friend template, seed chicken)
cast.Ned's hen: flat brown hen #B8682F, red comb, orange beak
cast.Blob's rooster: flat orange rooster #D9762B, golden neck, dark green tail

beats.lose: the sky snaps from golden morning to night, all three look up in shock
beats.money: Blob's gold coin pile sinks into the ground in a puff of dust
beats.houses: the three cottages sink into the ground - only Sara's front door is left standing
beats.fields: the wheat fields flatten to bare soil
beats.gone: dawn on bare land, all three slump, a tumbleweed rolls by
beats.hungry: they sit on the ground while three days and nights flash past, faces pale
beats.chicken: one chicken drops into each pair of arms, feathers puff
beats.cooks: night: Ned stirs a pot over a campfire, a brown feather drifts down
beats.best: close-up: Ned slurps from a bowl, eyes closed, blissful
beats.last: the fire goes out, Ned alone in the dark with an empty bowl
beats.hen: morning: Sara beside her lone door, her white hen pecking
beats.egg: the hen stands up, an egg pops out under her, Sara picks it up
beats.rooster: Blob proudly holds his rooster, it crows
beats.noeggs: the rooster gets up - nothing; punch-in on Blob's confused face, the rooster shrugs
beats.knocks: Blob walks to Sara's free-standing door and knocks; it swings open
beats.meet: rooster and hen side by side, a red heart pops above them
beats.share: Blob and Sara shake hands, a basket of eggs pops in
beats.chicks: Blob smugly holds an egg up to the light; it glows; the camera dives into it
beats.weeks: inside the egg (cross-section): a chick grows as days and nights flash
beats.hatch: flash: four eggs crack in the nest, chicks pop out, Blob overjoyed
beats.months: time-lapse: chicks grow into hens, the trees turn autumn orange
beats.laying: each hen pops an egg in turn, Blob cheers
beats.fills: a coop appears and the flock doubles 4 - 8 - 16 - 32 as the camera rushes up
beats.keep: Blob runs back and forth among the chickens, sweating
beats.hires: Ned walks in, thin and pale; Blob waves him over and points at the coop
beats.pays: Blob drops eggs into Ned's basket one by one
beats.same1: flash back: the three holding their single chickens
beats.poor: Ned sits by a cold fire pit
beats.comfortable: whip to Sara: small hut, hen, basket of eggs, content
beats.rich: whip to Blob: big coop, huge flock, arms crossed, smug
beats.subscribe: flash back to frame 0 (houses, coins, fields), subscribe button + click, last frame = frame 0
